# Unlisted Rooms

> Room rentals, subleases, lease takeovers and roommate searches from public Facebook housing groups in San Francisco/Bay Area and New York City, organized by neighborhood, rent and dates. Every result links to the original Facebook post.

Data is collected from public Facebook groups and structured by an AI model, hourly between 6 AM and 10 PM Pacific time. Posts are not verified; confirm details with the poster. The site does not host listings.
